findings.observed: After editing the note to "compare note alpha beta" and clicking Save, reloading the Notes page restored "hello world". The edited note was not persisted.
findings.expected_basis: The approved goal requires a user to write a note and save it; the README states that Save persists the note.
findings.reproduction: Open the Notes page, replace the note with "compare note alpha beta", click Save, reload the page, and observe that the original "hello world" value returns.

findings.observed: After clicking Save, no visible "Saved ✓" status appeared.
findings.expected_basis: The candidate README explicitly promises that the status shows "Saved ✓" after saving.
findings.reproduction: Edit the note and click Save; inspect the page for the documented save confirmation.

notes: The material Notes journey was completed. The core save behavior is broken and remains unresolved.
